name: WASP-33
description: Star of 7,430 K, 122 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: WASP-33 b crosses WASP-33 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname CHAKRABARTY__AMP__SENGUPTA_2019): st_teff 7430, st_rad 1.444, st_mass 1.495

quotes.title: HD 15082
quotes.card: A hot Jupiter type extrasolar planet, named WASP-33b or HD 15082b, orbits this star with an orbital period of 1.22 days.
quotes.introduction: It is the first Delta Scuti variable known to host a planet.
